verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers webhooks for real-time event notifications and card authorization controls that let users specify rules for card usage, which together provide primitives for reactive automation, but there is no documented no-code/rules-engine feature that lets a user directly define 'if event X then action Y' automation without building custom integration logic. Missing for 10: an explicit rules/automation engine, examples of rule-triggered actions beyond card authorization, and evidence of end-to-end automated workflows tied to webhook events.
